ValidationRule.description: NPI and Semi Opp Type - Must add Product Hierarchy at stage 2
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR ( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "NPI_Opportunity", $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Semi_Opportunity" ), OR( ISPICKVAL( StageName , "2 - Requirement Definition/Technical Evl"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "3 - Technical Qualification/Approval "), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "4 - Commercial Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "5 - Business Award – Won"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "6 - Production Order on Backlog"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost"), CONTAINS(TEXT(StageName), "Other")
), OR( ISPICKVAL( Segment__c, "" ), ISPICKVAL( Division__c, "" ), ISPICKVAL( Business_Unit__c, "" ), ISPICKVAL( Product_LineGlobal__c, "" )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Product Hierarchy for NPI and Semi OPP - Segment - Division - Business Unit - Product Line
